# Source Policy

## Preferred source order
1. Official product/framework documentation
2. Official specifications or standards
3. Original research papers / official research publications
4. Official organization engineering/research pages
5. Secondary sources only when primary sources do not answer the question

## Avoid
- Treating old tutorials as current API guidance
- Using job-board copies when the organization's own role page exists
- Presenting social-media claims as established technical facts
- Generalizing one benchmark or experiment into universal best practice

## Courseware note
Current-source checks should improve accuracy without cluttering instructional material. Keep citations/source notes in instructor notes or review artifacts when inline sourcing would distract from the lesson.
